peptides.name: BPC-157
peptides.summary: A 15-amino-acid synthetic peptide derived from a sequence found in human gastric juice protein, studied almost entirely in rodent models.
peptides.title: BPC-157: What It Is and How to Read a Supplier's COA
peptides.h1: BPC-157: a research guide to the peptide and its documentation
peptides.metaDesc: An in-depth research overview of BPC-157: what the evidence does and does not show, how to read a COA, salt forms, and suppliers that list it. Research use only.

peptides.name: TB-500
facts: Varies by vendor; often a short fragment
peptides.summary: A research peptide sold under the name of its parent protein, thymosin beta-4. What a vendor means by TB-500 is not standardized.
peptides.title: TB-500: Which Molecule Is It? A Research Guide and COA Checklist
peptides.h1: TB-500: a research guide to a name that means more than one molecule
peptides.metaDesc: TB-500 is sold under one name but means different molecules. Learn how it relates to thymosin beta-4, what a useful COA shows, and which suppliers list it.

peptides.name: GHK-Cu
peptides.summary: A naturally occurring tripeptide that binds copper, widely used in cosmetic ingredient research and studied in cell and tissue models.
peptides.title: GHK-Cu: Copper Peptide Research Guide and How to Check a COA
peptides.h1: GHK-Cu: a research guide to the copper peptide and its documentation
peptides.metaDesc: A research overview of GHK-Cu: the peptide-plus-copper structure, why it is blue, what a convincing COA includes, and which suppliers list it. Research use only.

peptides.name: Tesamorelin
peptides.summary: A modified 44-amino-acid GHRH analog. A pharmaceutical version exists as a prescription drug; research-grade material is a separate, unregulated supply.
peptides.title: Tesamorelin: Research Guide, COA Checks and Suppliers
peptides.h1: Tesamorelin: a research guide to the one peptide here with a drug counterpart
peptides.metaDesc: Tesamorelin explained for researchers: how it differs from the approved drug, why a 44-residue peptide is hard to make well, what a COA should show, and suppliers.

peptides.name: Ipamorelin
peptides.summary: A synthetic pentapeptide that acts on the ghrelin receptor, often described as more selective than older secretagogues in preclinical work.
peptides.title: Ipamorelin: Research Guide, Chirality and How to Read a COA
peptides.h1: Ipamorelin: a research guide to a short peptide with unusual building blocks
peptides.metaDesc: Ipamorelin explained for researchers: its non-natural residues, why chirality matters on a certificate of analysis, blends with CJC-1295, and suppliers that list it.

peptides.name: CJC-1295
peptides.also: With DAC; without DAC is Modified GRF (1-29)
peptides.summary: A GHRH analog sold in two chemically different forms under similar names. Confirming which one you are buying is the main task.
peptides.vortexNote: Vortex lists CJC-1295 (no DAC) only as a blend with ipamorelin.
peptides.title: CJC-1295 With or Without DAC: Research Guide and Label Check
peptides.h1: CJC-1295: a research guide to two molecules sold under one name
peptides.metaDesc: CJC-1295 with DAC and without DAC are different molecules. Learn the mass difference, how to spot mislabeled listings, how blends work, and suppliers that list it.

peptides.name: MOTS-c
peptides.also: Mitochondrial open reading frame of the 12S rRNA-c
peptides.summary: A 16-amino-acid peptide encoded in mitochondrial DNA, studied in metabolism and aging research in cell and animal models.
peptides.title: MOTS-c: Research Guide, Oxidation Checks and Suppliers
peptides.h1: MOTS-c: a research guide to the peptide encoded in mitochondrial DNA
peptides.metaDesc: MOTS-c explained for researchers: how it was discovered, what the preclinical evidence shows, why methionine oxidation matters on a COA, and suppliers that list it.

peptides.name: NAD+
peptides.summary: NAD+ is a coenzyme, not a peptide. It is listed alongside peptides by most vendors, so it appears in this directory for comparison.
peptides.title: NAD+: Research Guide, Stability and What a COA Should Show
peptides.h1: NAD+: a research guide to the coenzyme sold alongside peptides
peptides.metaDesc: NAD+ is a coenzyme, not a peptide. Learn how it differs, why stability and storage matter, what a COA should include, and which suppliers list it. Research use only.

peptides.name: Semax
peptides.summary: A synthetic analog of an ACTH fragment with a stabilizing Pro-Gly-Pro tail, developed and studied mainly in Russia.
peptides.title: Semax: Research Guide to the ACTH-Derived Heptapeptide and Its COA
peptides.h1: Semax: a research guide to the ACTH-derived peptide from Moscow
peptides.metaDesc: Semax explained for researchers: its origin as an ACTH(4-10) analog, regulatory status, the vial versus N-acetyl versus spray forms, what a COA should show, and suppliers.

peptides.name: Selank
peptides.summary: A synthetic analog of the immune peptide tuftsin with a stabilizing Pro-Gly-Pro tail, studied in Russian laboratories.
peptides.title: Selank: Research Guide to the Tuftsin-Derived Peptide and Its COA
peptides.h1: Selank: a research guide to the peptide built on tuftsin
peptides.metaDesc: Selank explained for researchers: its origin from the immune peptide tuftsin, what the research does and does not show, vial versus spray forms, COA checks, and suppliers.

peptides.name: KPV
peptides.summary: A tripeptide fragment of alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone, studied in cell and animal models of inflammation.
peptides.title: KPV: Research Guide to the alpha-MSH Tripeptide and Its COA
peptides.h1: KPV: a research guide to the three-residue fragment of alpha-MSH
peptides.metaDesc: KPV explained for researchers: where it sits in alpha-MSH, what the preclinical research shows, why counter-ions matter for a 342 Da peptide, COA checks and suppliers.

peptides.name: SS-31
peptides.summary: A small synthetic peptide that concentrates at the inner mitochondrial membrane. A pharmaceutical form, elamipretide, has been in clinical development.
peptides.title: SS-31 (Elamipretide): Research Guide, Structure Checks and COA
peptides.h1: SS-31: a research guide to elamipretide and its non-natural building blocks
peptides.metaDesc: SS-31 explained for researchers: how it relates to approved elamipretide, why D-arginine and Dmt matter on a certificate of analysis, and suppliers that list it.
